profile.headline: Software Engineer & Architect
profile.summary: With over 15 years of experience in software engineering and systems architecture, I am passionate about (and pretty good at, if I do say so myself) creating innovative, evolvable, and high-performance products that solve complex problems.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Leading solution architecture and engineering on PCI certified card-payment processing and authentication products while remaining hands-on with the development and DevOps side of things.

The bulk of my time in this role was focused on design and engineering of high availability, high performance, scalable and agile microservice oriented solutions in .NET and Python on Azure as well as driving the refinement of engineering and DevOps practices towards continuous delivery and operational excellence.

positions.title: Senior Services Developer
positions.description: Skills: .NET · Docker Products · Containerization · Azure DevOps Services · Systems Design · ASP.NET MVC · SOLID Design Principles · REST APIs · Continuous Integration (CI) · Scrum · SQL · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · ASP.NET Web API · Software Architecture · Git · Azure Functions · Agile Methodologies · ASP.NET Core · .NET Core · Distributed Systems · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Software Solutions Architect
positions.description: Full lifecycle software development role, from solution architecture through to operation. Working primarily with .NET, Azure and Sitecore in a highly customer-focused environment to deliver web solutions and legacy / cloud application migrations.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · Azure DevOps Services · Systems Design · Continuous Integration (CI) · Scrum · SQL · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Software Architecture · Angular · .NET Framework · Azure Functions · ASP.NET Core · .NET Core · Distributed Systems · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Software Developer in Test
positions.description: Automated test developer during full rebuild of vouchercloud.com infrastructure. Responsible for developing automated integration tests across several APIs, automated front end / UI tests using custom frameworks based on Selenium WebDriver and load testing.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · ASP.NET MVC · REST APIs · Continuous Integration (CI) · Scrum · SQL · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · ASP.NET Web API · Entity Framework · Git · .NET Framework · Agile Methodologies · ASP.NET Core

positions.title: RightNow Systems Developer
positions.description: Manage every aspect of a mid-sized RightNow CX implementation. Improving and adding product functionality through extensibility frameworks as well developing in-house software to meet business needs.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · ASP.NET MVC · Scrum · SQL · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · ASP.NET Web API · Entity Framework · C (Programming Language) · Git · .NET Framework
